audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Level 1 and put Skill at 6 and first item, while the prose says 'Urgot owns the first three levels' and 'Once you hit W and then 6 this becomes a real fight'. Rated HARD 6/10 on a dead-even 50% win rate.
audit.corrected: EVEN 5/10 and the chart realigned in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text and Purge's ranking curve was never mentioned.
audit.why: Purge is 12/9/6/3/0 seconds — it goes from a real cooldown to permanently available as he ranks it, which is the whole shape of the lane.
audit.corrected: Written into the Level 1 and 4-5 rows and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Purge with %-max-HP damage and credits his passive with a shield; neither is in Riot's text, and Purge's targeting rule is missing.
audit.why: Riot on Purge: 'Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.' So it self-slows (you can walk out of its 490), and being tagged by Corrosive Charge is what makes you the target. Riot on Disdain: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself' — the shield is on E, not the passive. Echoing Flames, the passive, is only leg blasts from autos and Purge. Purge's damage type is not described as percent max health anywhere in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Purge's prioritisation and self-slow, and the shield reassigned to Disdain; the unsupported %-max-HP claim removed.

audit.why: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s is the punishable one — it is both his flip and his shield. Corrosive Charge is 10-8s and Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown block, trading rules and don'ts.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Purge is 12s at rank 1 but 0 at rank 5, and it prioritises champions he has already tagged with Corrosive Charge. Do not get marked.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Urgot's Disdain is down.
edits.after: Urgot owns 2. Purge slows him while he fires — walk out of the 490 rather than trading into it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash arrives. Disdain is 14-16s and it shields him on the charge, so bait it out before you commit a snip.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even now: your %-max-HP snips answer his bulk, but Purge's cooldown is falling toward zero. Trade only while unmarked.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Drop Hallowed Mist as Disdain lands: Purge only hits nearby enemies at 490, so untargetable in the fog his whole combo hits nothing.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker plus anti-heal — your %-max-HP snips out-pace his sustained Purge DPS.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Coinflip late. Fear Beyond Death is a 2500-range impale that executes, so never sit low while his R is off cooldown.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it, then Snip. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Purge (12s at rank 1, 0 at rank 5): it locks onto whoever he last hit with an ability, and it slows him while he fires. - Disdain (14-16s): the flip, and his shield. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Urgot with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Urgot with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Disdain whiffs — no flip and no shield for 14-16s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing inside Purge's 490 after Corrosive Charge has tagged you, which is exactly who it prioritises.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then Snip. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The flip, and it shields him. Bait it, then snip — 14-16 seconds.

edits.after: Purge slows Urgot himself while it fires — just walk out of 490.

edits.after: Disdain shields him on the charge, so eating it costs you twice.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Dodge it, then Snip. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Purge locks onto whoever Corrosive Charge tagged and slows him while it fires; Disdain also shields him.

edits.before: Dodge his flip — Snip his HP when his W is down. Gwen wins by trading around Urgot's Disdain and cashing the pattern: dodge his flip and Snip him on his W cooldown.
edits.after: Dodge the Disdain flip and never be the target Corrosive Charge tagged — Purge prioritises it. Then snip his HP from inside the mist while he is slowed.

edits.before: Urgot owns the first three levels — his W Purge fires his shotgun legs on a short cooldown and chunks you with %-max-HP damage while you've got a slow cone Q, no E dash yet, and no Hallowed Mist to hide in. Don't walk up to trade Q for his Purge; you'll lose the DPS race and feed his passive shield and sustain. Last-hit at max Q range, soak the shove, and respect that his Disdain charge can flip you under tower or into a Purge burst. Your %-HP Q does answer his eventual tankiness, but at level 1-2 you simply don't have the kit to fight him.
edits.after: Urgot owns the first three levels — his W Purge fires his shotgun legs on a falling cooldown, 12 seconds at rank 1 down to nothing at rank 5, while you have a slow cone Q, no E dash yet, and no Hallowed Mist to hide in. Don't walk up to trade Q for his Purge; it prioritises whoever he last tagged with Corrosive Charge and it triggers Echoing Flames off his legs. Last-hit at max Q range, soak the shove, and respect that Disdain shields him on the charge and can flip you under tower. Your %-HP Q does answer his eventual bulk, but at level 1-2 you simply don't have the kit to fight him.

notes: Purge was credited with percent-max-health damage and Urgot's passive with a shield; Riot's text supports neither. The shield is on Disdain and the passive is Echoing Flames. The two facts that actually make this lane playable — Purge prioritises whoever Corrosive Charge tagged, and it self-slows so you can walk out of its 490 — were absent from both layers, as was Purge's 12/9/6/3/0 cooldown curve.
